title: Smooth Λ-Lipschitz mollifications of a Λ-Lipschitz map
statement: For all N, N', Λ ∈ ℝ≥0 and every Λ-Lipschitz F : ℝ^N → ℝ^{N'} there are maps Fs_j : ℝ^N → ℝ^{N'} (j ∈ ℕ), each C^∞ (ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞)) and Λ-Lipschitz, with dist(Fs_j(x), F(x)) ≤ Λ/(j+1) for all j and x.
lean_statement: ∀ (N N' : ℕ) (Λ : NNReal) (F : Euclid N → Euclid N'), LipschitzWith Λ F → ∃ Fs : ℕ → Euclid N → Euclid N', (∀ j, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (Fs j)) ∧ (∀ j, LipschitzWith Λ (Fs j)) ∧ ∀ (j : ℕ) (x : Euclid N), dist (Fs j x) (F x) ≤ (Λ : ℝ) / ((j : ℝ) + 1)
